PostToolUse.description: Auto-lint Rust files after edits with cargo clippy

hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.rs) cargo clippy --quiet 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac

Stop.description: Scan for unsafe blocks without SAFETY comments and TODO/FIXME markers

hooks.command: echo '--- Unsafe blocks without // SAFETY: ---' && grep -rn 'unsafe' src/ --include='*.rs' 2>/dev/null | grep -v '// SAFETY:' | grep -v '#\[cfg' | grep -v 'unsafe_code' | head -20; echo '--- TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX markers ---' && grep -rn 'TODO\|FIXME\|HACK\|XXX' src/ --include='*.rs' 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo '[NanoVec] Review any matches above' || true

Stop.description: Scan for hardcoded secrets before session ends

hooks.command: grep -rn 'API_KEY\|SECRET\|PASSWORD\|PRIVATE_KEY\|Bearer ' --include='*.rs' --include='*.toml' --include='*.yml' --include='*.yaml' . 2>/dev/null | grep -v target | grep -v '.env.example' | head -20 && echo '[NanoVec] Review any matches above for hardcoded secrets' || true
